The entry's own value -- a domain name, wildcard glob, or regular expression (depending on
Ninlil.Web.Models.FilterListEntryWriteRequest.Kind) for a Ninlil.Dns.Common.Enum.DnsFilterListKindEnum.Domain list, or an IP
address/CIDR network for a Ninlil.Dns.Common.Enum.DnsFilterListKindEnum.ResponseIp/
Ninlil.Dns.Common.Enum.DnsFilterListKindEnum.ClientSource list (where Ninlil.Web.Models.FilterListEntryWriteRequest.Kind must be
Ninlil.Dns.Common.Enum.DnsFilterEntryKindEnum.Domain, the default).

comment.description: Free-form operator notes about this entry.

FilterListEntryWriteRequest.description:
This class carries the fields used to create a new entry directly in a
Ninlil.Dns.Common.Enum.DnsFilterListSourceEnum.Local list
(`POST /api/filter-lists/{listId}/entries`). See
Ninlil.Web.Controllers.FilterListEntriesController for why this, and every other write action on
this nested resource, is rejected for a Ninlil.Dns.Common.Enum.DnsFilterListSourceEnum.Subscribed
list.

name.description: An operator-chosen, human-readable, unique name for this list.

subscriptionUrl.description:
The URL a Ninlil.Dns.Common.Enum.DnsFilterListSourceEnum.Subscribed list's entries are periodically
fetched from. Required when Ninlil.Web.Models.FilterListWriteRequest.Source is Ninlil.Dns.Common.Enum.DnsFilterListSourceEnum.Subscribed,
otherwise ignored.

refreshInterval.description:
How often a Ninlil.Dns.Common.Enum.DnsFilterListSourceEnum.Subscribed list's entries are refetched.
Ignored for a Ninlil.Dns.Common.Enum.DnsFilterListSourceEnum.Local list.

isDisabled.description: Whether the list starts out disabled.

comments.description: Free-form operator notes about the list.

FilterListWriteRequest.description:
This class carries the fields used to create a new block/allow list
(`POST /api/filter-lists`).

FilterPatternPreviewMatch.description: This class carries whether one sample domain matched a previewed pattern.

value.description: The candidate pattern text, exactly as an operator is currently typing it.

sampleDomains.description:
The domains to test Ninlil.Web.Models.FilterPatternPreviewRequest.Value against. When omitted or empty, this controller's
own small, built-in default sample set is used instead (see
`FilterPatternPreviewController.DefaultSampleDomains`).

FilterPatternPreviewRequest.description:
This class carries a request to preview which of a sample set of domains a candidate
filter-list-entry pattern would match (`POST /api/filter-pattern-preview`).

isValid.description:
Whether Ninlil.Web.Models.FilterPatternPreviewRequest.Value actually compiles as the
requested Ninlil.Web.Models.FilterPatternPreviewRequest.Kind -- the exact same compilation
`FilterListEntriesController` itself requires before persisting a
Ninlil.Dns.Common.Enum.DnsFilterEntryKindEnum.Wildcard/Ninlil.Dns.Common.Enum.DnsFilterEntryKindEnum.Regex
entry, run here read-only, before the operator has even saved anything.

error.description: A human-readable reason Ninlil.Web.Models.FilterPatternPreviewResult.IsValid is false, or null when it is true.

matches.description:
Every sample domain actually tested, and whether the pattern matched it -- empty when
Ninlil.Web.Models.FilterPatternPreviewResult.IsValid is false, since an uncompilable pattern is never
tested against anything.

FilterPatternPreviewResult.description:
This class carries the result of previewing a candidate filter-list-entry pattern --
the response shape for `POST /api/filter-pattern-preview`.

FilteringSettingsDetail.description:
This record is the REST representation of this host's own currently-effective
`DnsFilterOptions`. No secret material is involved, so this record's own fields are
the exact same ones a `PATCH` to the same endpoint accepts.

email.description:
The e-mail address to look up. Never confirmed or denied to actually match an account by
this request's own response -- see M:Ninlil.Web.Controllers.AuthController.ForgotPassword(Ninlil.Web.Models.ForgotPasswordRequest,System.Threading.CancellationToken)'s
own doc comment.

ForgotPasswordRequest.description:
This class carries the e-mail address a genuinely anonymous, self-service Forgot Password
request submits to M:Ninlil.Web.Controllers.AuthController.ForgotPassword(Ninlil.Web.Models.ForgotPasswordRequest,System.Threading.CancellationToken).

ForgotPasswordResult.description:
This class carries M:Ninlil.Web.Controllers.AuthController.ForgotPassword(Ninlil.Web.Models.ForgotPasswordRequest,System.Threading.CancellationToken)'s own always-
identical response -- the exact same Ninlil.Web.Models.ForgotPasswordResult.Message, every time, regardless of
whether a reset link was actually sent, so a caller can never distinguish "sent" from "not
sent" by response shape.

name.description: This forwarder's own human-readable name.

definitionString.description: This forwarder's own definition string, exactly as stored.

sortOrder.description: This forwarder's own position among every other configured global forwarder.

isDisabled.description: Whether this forwarder is currently disabled.

comments.description: Free-form operator notes about this forwarder.

updatedAtUtc.description: When this forwarder was last modified, or null if never.

originatingNodeId.description:
The cluster node this forwarder was last created or modified on (the cluster's own
operational config sync), or null on a deployment that has never had clustering
enabled.

ForwarderDetail.description:
This class carries a single global upstream forwarder's own fields, for list, single-item,
and creation responses. No secret material is involved anywhere in this entity -- a
forwarder definition string is not a credential -- so, unlike `TsigKeyDetail`/
`DnssecKeyDetail`/`CloudProviderCredentialDetail`, there is no reveal-once policy
to apply here at all.

skip.description: How many items were skipped before this page began.

take.description: The maximum number of items this page could contain.

totalCount.description: The total number of items across every page.

ForwarderDetailPagedResult.description:
This class wraps a single page of a larger list -- the shape every list endpoint in this
project's REST API returns, offset/limit paginated (a sane default/max page size is enough
at this project's own homelab/small-org target scale; a cursor-based scheme's extra
complexity is not needed).

name.description: An operator-chosen, human-readable, unique name for this forwarder.

definitionString.description:
The forwarder's own Technitium/AdGuard Home-style definition string -- a bare address, a
`udp://`/`tcp://`/`tls://`/`https://`/`quic://` URL, or an
`sdns://` DNSCrypt stamp -- validated against the real
`IUpstreamForwarderDefinitionParser` (and, for an `sdns://` stamp,
`DnsCryptStampParser`) before this forwarder is ever persisted, rather than accepting
an arbitrary string, the same "validate against the real codec/parser" discipline
Ninlil.Web.Controllers.RecordsController already applies to a record's own `data` field.

sortOrder.description: This forwarder's own position among every other configured global forwarder -- lower values are preferred first.

isDisabled.description: Whether the forwarder starts out (or is currently) disabled.

comments.description: Free-form operator notes about this forwarder.

ForwarderWriteRequest.description:
This class carries the fields used to create or fully replace a global upstream forwarder
(`POST`/`PUT /api/forwarders`).

ForwardingSettingsDetail.description:
This record is the REST representation of this host's own currently-effective
`ForwardingOptions`. No secret material is involved, so this record's own fields are
the exact same ones a `PATCH` to the same endpoint accepts. Forwarder entries
themselves (the actual upstream addresses) are a separate resource, already fully
CRUD-able via `ForwardersController` -- this record covers only the engine-level
toggle and failover/health-check tuning that applies across every configured forwarder.

requiredLength.description: The fewest characters a new password may contain.

requiredUniqueChars.description: The fewest distinct characters a new password must contain.

requireDigit.description: Whether a new password must contain at least one digit.

requireLowercase.description: Whether a new password must contain at least one lowercase letter.

requireUppercase.description: Whether a new password must contain at least one uppercase letter.

requireNonAlphanumeric.description: Whether a new password must contain at least one non-alphanumeric character.

defaultLockoutTimeSpan.description: How long an account is locked out once Ninlil.Web.Models.IdentitySettingsDetail.MaxFailedAccessAttempts is reached.

maxFailedAccessAttempts.description: How many consecutive failed sign-in attempts trigger a lockout.

allowedForNewUsers.description: Whether lockout applies to a brand-new account, not only an established one.

IdentitySettingsDetail.description:
This record is the REST representation of this host's own currently-effective password-
complexity and account-lockout policy -- Microsoft.AspNetCore.Identity.IdentityOptions.Password and
Microsoft.AspNetCore.Identity.IdentityOptions.Lockout, ASP.NET Core Identity's own built-in policy classes,
which shipped inside this project's identity layer from the very start but, before this
controller existed, had zero admin-facing configuration surface: changing either one
required hand-editing the configuration file's own `Identity` section and restarting.
No secret material is involved, so this record's own fields are the exact same ones a
`PATCH` to the same endpoint accepts. Deliberately excludes
Microsoft.AspNetCore.Identity.IdentityOptions.User/Microsoft.AspNetCore.Identity.IdentityOptions.SignIn/
Microsoft.AspNetCore.Identity.IdentityOptions.Tokens/Microsoft.AspNetCore.Identity.IdentityOptions.ClaimsIdentity/
Microsoft.AspNetCore.Identity.IdentityOptions.Stores -- structural choices this project's own identity
wiring depends on (unique e-mail enforcement, for one, which rejects an account with no e-mail), not
tunable policy in the sense this controller's own name promises.

durationMinutes.description:
How many minutes, from now, to pause for. Must be a positive number -- zero or negative is
rejected with a `400`Ninlil.Dns.Common.Exceptions.ValidationException.

InstantPauseRequest.description:
This class carries the fields used to start a new instant pause
(`POST /api/clients/{clientId}/pause` and its client-group counterpart) -- a
duration, rather than an explicit timestamp, since a one-click "15 min / 1 hour / until
tomorrow morning" UI is this feature's own primary use case, and a duration needs no
client-side time-zone/clock-skew reasoning at all: the server always computes
`PausedUntilUtc` as its own current instant plus this duration.

rememberMe.description:
With Ninlil.Dns.Common.Enum.RefreshTokenDeliveryEnum.Cookie delivery, whether the session should
outlive the browser: a persistent cookie and the long refresh lifetime when
true, otherwise a browser-session cookie and the short browser-session
lifetime. Ignored for Ninlil.Dns.Common.Enum.RefreshTokenDeliveryEnum.Body delivery, whose sessions
are always long-lived, exactly as before cookie delivery existed.

LoginRequest.description: This class carries the credentials a caller signs in with.

requiresTwoFactor.description: Whether a second authentication factor is still required.

mfaToken.description:
An opaque, short-lived token identifying this pending sign-in, to be echoed back to
`POST /api/auth/login/two-factor`. Only set when Ninlil.Web.Models.LoginResponse.RequiresTwoFactor is
true.

accessToken.description: The signed JSON Web Token access token, once sign-in is complete.

expiresAtUtc.description: The UTC date and time Ninlil.Web.Models.LoginResponse.AccessToken expires.

refreshToken.description:
The opaque refresh token, once sign-in is complete -- null when it was
delivered as a cookie instead.

LoginResponse.description:
This class carries the outcome of a sign-in attempt. Exactly one of two shapes applies:
either Ninlil.Web.Models.LoginResponse.RequiresTwoFactor is true and
Ninlil.Web.Models.LoginResponse.MfaToken is set (the caller must next call
`POST /api/auth/login/two-factor`), or a full Ninlil.Web.Models.LoginResponse.AccessToken/
Ninlil.Web.Models.LoginResponse.RefreshToken pair is set because sign-in is already complete.

generatedAtUtc.description: When the loaded data was downloaded from the IEEE.

maLEntryCount.description: How many MA-L (24-bit) prefixes are loaded.

maMEntryCount.description: How many MA-M (28-bit) prefixes are loaded.

maSEntryCount.description: How many MA-S (36-bit) prefixes are loaded.

totalEntryCount.description: How many prefixes are loaded across all three registries.

lastRefreshAttemptUtc.description: When a refresh was last attempted, or null if never.

lastRefreshError.description: Why that attempt failed, or null when it did not.

lastSuccessfulCheckUtc.description: When a refresh last completed successfully, or null if never.

nextRefreshDueUtc.description:
When the next automatic refresh is due, or null while automatic refresh
is disabled.

MacVendorDataStatusDetail.description:
This record reports the vendor data currently answering lookups and the refresh history
behind it -- returned inside Ninlil.Web.Models.MacVendorSettingsDetail and by an on-demand
refresh.

enableAutomaticRefresh.description: Whether the IEEE registries are periodically re-downloaded.

refreshInterval.description: How long to wait after a successful check before checking again.

maLRegistryUrl.description: Where the MA-L (24-bit) registry CSV is downloaded from.

maMRegistryUrl.description: Where the MA-M (28-bit) registry CSV is downloaded from.

maSRegistryUrl.description: Where the MA-S (36-bit) registry CSV is downloaded from.

dataFilePath.description: Where refreshed data is persisted (read-only here).

MacVendorSettingsDetail.description:
This record is the REST representation of MAC vendor lookup's currently-effective
`MacVendorLookupOptions`, plus a read-only report of the vendor data currently loaded.
Every settings field except DataFilePath is also accepted by a
`PATCH` to the same endpoint; that one is an on-disk path, read once at startup and
configuration-file-only like every other state path.

name.description:
This service's own stable, operator-facing name -- the exact value a
`POST /api/services/{name}/start`-shaped action's own route parameter addresses it by.

isRunning.description:
Whether this service is genuinely running right now -- see
Ninlil.Dns.Server.Core.Services.IManagedServiceRegistration.IsRunning's own doc comment for exactly what
that means for a given service (a real, independently-observed signal for every DNS
transport listener; "has start been called more recently than stop" for a background
maintenance loop with no richer signal of its own).

ManagedServiceSummary.description:
This record is the REST representation of one Ninlil.Dns.Server.Core.Services.IManagedServiceRegistration --
a DNS transport listener or background maintenance loop this server runs, and whether it
is genuinely running right now.

NotifySettingsDetail.description:
This record is the REST representation of this host's own currently-effective
`NotifyOptions` -- how this server sends RFC 1996 NOTIFY messages to a zone's
configured secondaries. No secret material is involved, so this record's own fields are
the exact same ones a `PATCH` to the same endpoint accepts.

enable.description: Whether this host is configured to federate admin sign-in through OpenID Connect.

displayName.description: The label the Angular admin SPA's own login page renders on its "Sign in with SSO" button.

authority.description: The identity provider's own issuer URL.

clientId.description: The OAuth 2.0 client identifier this host was registered under.

clientSecretConfigured.description:
Whether `OidcSsoOptions.ClientSecretEncrypted` currently has a value -- the secret
itself is never returned by a `GET`.

scopes.description: The OpenID Connect scopes requested during the authorization code flow.

OidcSsoSettingsDetail.description:
This record is the REST representation of this host's own currently-effective
`OidcSsoOptions`. Ninlil.Web.Models.OidcSsoSettingsDetail.ClientSecretConfigured stands in for the real client
secret, never returned by a `GET` -- the same reveal-once posture every other
secret-bearing setting in this project already follows.

OutboundQuerySettingsDetail.description:
This record is the REST representation of this host's own currently-effective
`OutboundQueryOptions`. No secret material is involved, so this record's own fields
are the exact same ones a `PATCH` to the same endpoint accepts.

port.description: The port both the UDP and TCP listeners bind to.

tcpIdleTimeout.description: How long a TCP connection may sit completely idle before this server closes it.

maxConcurrentTcpConnections.description: How many TCP connections this server accepts at once.

PlainTransportSettingsDetail.description:
This record is the REST representation of Plain DNS's own `PlainProtocolOptions`.
Deliberately has no `Enable` field -- Plain DNS has none of its own either, since it is
this project's baseline "this is a DNS server at all" transport rather than a
capability-expanding toggle, and starts unconditionally.

name.description: The preset that was applied.

note.description:
A reminder that some settings this preset touches are only read via
Microsoft.Extensions.Options.IOptions`1, not
Microsoft.Extensions.Options.IOptionsMonitor`1, and therefore need a
restart before they take effect.

PresetApplyResult.description: This record is returned after a preset is successfully applied.

name.description: The preset's own stable name, for example `"Baseline"`.

description.description: A short, human-readable summary of what this preset changes and why.

configurationSettingCount.description: How many individual configuration leaves this preset overwrites.

filterListSubscriptionCount.description: How many block/allow-list subscriptions this preset attaches.

PresetSummary.description:
This record is the REST representation of one built-in Ninlil.Dns.Server.Presets.PresetDefinition
-- summary only, not the full leaf-by-leaf settings list, since a preset is applied as one
atomic action, never inspected field-by-field through this endpoint.

defaultEnabled.description:
The global default -- overridable per zone via `ZoneEntity.AutoManagePtrRecords`,
which this setting supplies a value for only when that field is left unset.

defaultIpv6ReverseZonePrefixBits.description:
The global default IPv6 reverse-zone grouping granularity, in bits -- overridable per zone
via `ZoneEntity.PtrIpv6PrefixLength`.

PtrSyncSettingsDetail.description:
This record is the REST representation of this host's own currently-effective
`PtrSyncOptions` -- the global default for whether a
`ZoneTypeEnum.Primary`/`ZoneTypeEnum.CloudPrimary` zone's own A/AAAA record set is
automatically mirrored into its enclosing reverse zone, used whenever a zone's own
`ZoneEntity.AutoManagePtrRecords` is not explicitly set. No secret material is
involved, so this record's own field is the exact same one a `PATCH` to the same
endpoint accepts.

deletedCount.description: How many entries were permanently removed.

QueryLogClearResult.description: This class carries the outcome of an explicit "clear the log" action.

enable.description: Whether an already-answered query is persisted to the query log at all.

retentionPeriod.description: How long a query log entry is kept before it ages out.

maxRetainedEntries.description: The largest number of entries the query log is ever allowed to hold.

cleanupInterval.description: How often the retention sweep runs.

QueryLoggingSettingsDetail.description:
This record is the REST representation of this host's own currently-effective
`QueryLoggingOptions`. No secret material is involved, so this record's own fields
are the exact same ones a `PATCH` to the same endpoint accepts.

RabbitMqBrokerSettingsDetail.description:
This record carries `RabbitMqEventBrokerOptions`'s own settings, minus
`Password` -- deliberately never returned by a `GET`, the same reveal-once
posture this project's every other secret-bearing entity already follows, even though this
particular secret lives in a plaintext config file rather than an `IDataProtector`-
encrypted column.

RateLimitingSettingsDetail.description:
This record is the REST representation of this host's own currently-effective
`DnsRateLimitOptions`. No secret material is involved, so this record's own fields are
the exact same ones a `PATCH` to the same endpoint accepts.

RecordDetail.description: This class carries a record's full state, for both list and single-item responses.

skip.description: How many items were skipped before this page began.

take.description: The maximum number of items this page could contain.

totalCount.description: The total number of items across every page.

RecordDetailPagedResult.description:
This class wraps a single page of a larger list -- the shape every list endpoint in this
project's REST API returns, offset/limit paginated (a sane default/max page size is enough
at this project's own homelab/small-org target scale; a cursor-based scheme's extra
complexity is not needed).

name.description: The record's owner name.

data.description:
The record's type-specific data, shaped exactly like the record type's own wire-format
model -- an `A` record's `{ "address": "203.0.113.5" }`, an `MX` record's
`{ "preference": 10, "exchange": "mail.example.com" }`, and so on.

isDisabled.description: Whether the record is currently disabled.

comments.description: Free-form operator notes about the record.

excludeFromSync.description: Whether the record is local-only, excluded from every sync path.

RecordWriteRequest.description:
This class carries every writable field of a `RecordEntity` -- used both to create a
new record (`POST /api/zones/{zoneId}/records`) and to fully replace an existing one
(`PUT /api/zones/{zoneId}/records/{id}`).

codes.description:
The 10 freshly-generated codes, each usable exactly once via
`POST /api/auth/login/two-factor` with `"RecoveryCode"` as its own
Ninlil.Web.Models.TwoFactorLoginRequest.Provider. Generating a new batch immediately
invalidates every code from any previous batch, the same "replace wholesale" shape a TSIG
key's own secret rotation would have, if one existed.

RecoveryCodesResult.description:
This class carries a freshly-generated batch of single-use two-factor recovery codes, for
use as a fallback second factor when an authenticator app or a confirmed e-mail address is
unavailable. Exactly like every other secret this project generates (a TSIG key's shared
secret, a webhook subscription's own HMAC signing secret), these codes are shown exactly
once, in this one response -- Ninlil.Web.Models.TwoFactorStatus.RecoveryCodesRemaining is the
only thing any later request can ever learn about them again.

RecursiveRootHintServerDetail.description:
This record is the REST representation of one `RootHintServerOption` entry within
Ninlil.Web.Models.RecursiveSettingsDetail.RootHintServersOverride.

RecursiveSettingsDetail.description:
This record is the REST representation of this host's own currently-effective
`RecursiveServerOptions`. No secret material is involved, so this record's own fields
are the exact same ones a `PATCH` to the same endpoint accepts.

RecursiveTrustAnchorDetail.description:
This record is the REST representation of one `TrustAnchorOption` entry within
Ninlil.Web.Models.RecursiveSettingsDetail.TrustAnchorsOverride.

refreshToken.description:
The refresh token to act on. Omit it (send `{}`) to act on the browser's refresh
cookie instead; the response then rotates that cookie rather than returning a token.

RefreshRequest.description:
This class carries the refresh token a caller exchanges for a new access token, or revokes
at sign-out.

host.description: The database server's hostname or IP address.

databaseName.description: The name of the database (already-existing, empty or freely overwritable) to connect to.

password.description:
The password to authenticate with. Never echoed back by any `GET` -- there is nothing
to echo, since this REST boundary never stores this value anywhere itself; it exists only
for the single, synchronous duration of one `POST /api/storage/switch` call.

encryptionMode.description:
The engine's own connection-encryption mode, as a string matching one of that engine's own
real values -- see Ninlil.Web.Services.Storage.StorageConnectionStringAssembler's own
doc comment for the exact accepted values per engine.

RelationalStorageConnectionFields.description:
This record carries the structured connection fields `POST /api/storage/switch`
accepts for a PostgreSQL, MySQL, or SQL Server target -- all three server-based relational
engines share this same field shape. Ninlil.Web.Models.RelationalStorageConnectionFields.EncryptionMode's accepted values differ
by engine (each is validated against that engine's own real enum by
Ninlil.Web.Services.Storage.StorageConnectionStringAssembler, never a shared, invented
one) -- see that class's own doc comment for the exact accepted values per engine.

enable.description: Whether forwarded headers are currently honored at all.

knownProxies.description: Every individual IP address allowed to claim a forwarded client address.

knownNetworks.description: Every CIDR network allowed to claim a forwarded client address.

sharedSecretHeaderName.description: The request header a shared secret is read from, when one is configured.

sharedSecretConfigured.description: Whether a shared secret is currently configured.

lastModifiedUtc.description:
When this settings section was last written (the cluster's own operational config sync), or
null if it has never been written through this REST surface.

originatingNodeId.description:
The cluster node this settings section was last written on, or null
alongside Ninlil.Web.Models.ReverseProxySettingsDetail.LastModifiedUtc.

ReverseProxySettingsDetail.description:
This record is the REST representation of this host's own currently-effective
reverse-proxy trust configuration. Ninlil.Web.Models.ReverseProxySettingsDetail.SharedSecretConfigured reports whether a
shared secret is set without ever revealing its value -- the same "configured/not
configured" indicator `TwoFactorStatus.HasAuthenticator` and a webhook subscription's
own read-only HMAC-signing-secret indicator already use for a secret this endpoint's own
`Get` action never returns.

RewriteSettingsDetail.description:
This record is the REST representation of this host's own currently-effective
`DnsRewriteOptions`. No secret material is involved, so this record's own fields are
the exact same ones a `PATCH` to the same endpoint accepts. Rewrite entries themselves
(each individual domain/target override) are a separate resource, already fully CRUD-able
via `DnsRewritesController` -- this record covers only the engine-level toggle and
synthesized-answer TTL that applies across every configured rewrite.

RolePermissionRequest.description: This class carries a single permission to grant or revoke on a role.

name.description: The role's display name.

permissions.description: Every permission string currently granted by this role.

originatingNodeId.description:
The cluster node this role was most recently created or modified on, or
null on a single-node deployment -- mirrors `UserSummary`'s own
field of the same name.

clusterConflictNote.description:
A human-readable explanation of a genuine cluster role-name collision this role lost, or
null for the overwhelming majority of roles -- mirrors
`UserSummary.ClusterConflictNote`'s own field.

lastModifiedUtc.description:
The instant this role was last created or modified -- mirrors <c>UserSummary
.LastModifiedUtc</c>'s own field of the same name and purpose.

RoleSummary.description: This class carries a role's own summary, including every permission it currently grants.

skip.description: How many items were skipped before this page began.

take.description: The maximum number of items this page could contain.

totalCount.description: The total number of items across every page.

RoleSummaryPagedResult.description:
This class wraps a single page of a larger list -- the shape every list endpoint in this
project's REST API returns, offset/limit paginated (a sane default/max page size is enough
at this project's own homelab/small-org target scale; a cursor-based scheme's extra
complexity is not needed).

note.description:
A reminder that this write does not necessarily take effect immediately -- see
Ninlil.Web.Options.RuntimeConfigurationOptions's own doc comment.

RuntimeSettingsWriteResult.description:
This record is returned after a runtime settings `PATCH` is written to the
configuration file.

key.description: The catalog entry's own stable identifier (e.g. `google`).

description.description: A short, honest description of what enabling this entry does.

sourceDocumentationUrl.description: The engine's own official documentation page this entry's rewrite mappings were read from.

hostnameCount.description:
How many hostnames this entry redirects when enabled -- a quick indicator without echoing
every raw mapping back.

isEnabled.description:
Whether this server currently has every one of this entry's own rewrite mappings in place
as an enabled `DnsRewriteEntity` row.

SafeSearchDetail.description:
This class carries a single Safe Search catalog entry's own metadata, together with
whether it is currently enabled on this server -- the response shape for
`GET /api/safe-search`.

SecondaryZoneRefreshSettingsDetail.description:
This record is the REST representation of this host's own currently-effective
`SecondaryZoneRefreshOptions` -- how often the background loop that checks whether a
secondary zone is due for a refresh wakes up. This record's own fields are the exact same
ones a `PATCH` to the same endpoint accepts.

enableAutomaticCheck.description: Whether this host periodically checks Ninlil.Web.Models.SelfUpdateSettingsDetail.ReleaseFeedUrl at all.

releaseFeedUrl.description: The release feed URL checked, or an empty string if none is configured yet.

checkInterval.description: How often a real check is due.

SelfUpdateSettingsDetail.description:
This record is the REST representation of this host's own currently-effective
`SelfUpdateOptions`. No secret material is involved, so this record's own fields are
the exact same ones a `PATCH` to the same endpoint accepts.

configured.description: Whether a real release feed URL has ever been set.

currentVersion.description: This running process's own current version, as a plain dotted string.

latestKnownVersion.description:
The newest version the release feed has ever reported, as a plain dotted string, or
null if no check has ever completed successfully.

updateAvailable.description: Whether a genuinely newer release is currently known.

releaseUrl.description: A human-facing URL for the latest known release.

releaseNotes.description: Free-text release notes for the latest known release.

lastCheckedAtUtc.description: When a check was last attempted, or null if none has ever run.

lastCheckError.description: A short description of the most recent check's own failure, or null if it succeeded.

updateInstructions.description:
A plain-language description of what an operator should actually do about
Ninlil.Web.Models.SelfUpdateStatusDetail.UpdateAvailable -- see `Controllers.SelfUpdateController`'s own doc
comment for why this is honest, written guidance rather than a button that silently does
nothing.

SelfUpdateStatusDetail.description:
This record is the REST representation of the self-update checker's own currently-known
status -- the one field this whole feature exists to surface, plus enough context for an
operator to act on it. See `Controllers.SelfUpdateController`'s own doc comment for
what "acting on it" means today.

useTls.description: Whether the connection to the SMTP server is secured with TLS.

username.description: The username authenticated to the SMTP server with, or empty if it accepts anonymous connections.

passwordConfigured.description:
Whether `EmailSenderOptions.Password` currently has a value -- the password itself is
never returned by a `GET`, the same reveal-once posture every other secret-bearing
setting in this project already follows.

fromAddress.description: The e-mail address messages are sent from.

fromDisplayName.description: The display name messages are sent from.

SmtpSettingsDetail.description:
This record is the REST representation of this host's own currently-effective
`EmailSenderOptions` -- the SMTP server this host sends e-mail through (most notably,
e-mail-based two-factor authentication codes; a future self-service Forgot Password flow
will reuse the same infrastructure).

filePath.description: The path of the SQLite database file to switch onto.

SqliteStorageConnectionFields.description:
This record carries the structured connection fields `POST /api/storage/switch`
accepts for a SQLite target -- a single file path this process must be able to create and
write to.

enabled.description:
Whether the OpenID Connect authentication scheme is actually registered on this running
process right now -- see M:Ninlil.Web.Controllers.SsoController.Get's own doc comment for
why this is not simply `OidcSsoOptions.Enable`'s own raw value.

displayName.description: The label to render on the "Sign in with SSO" button.

SsoStatusResult.description:
This record tells an anonymous caller (the Angular admin SPA's own login page, before any
sign-in has happened) whether this host currently has a working OpenID Connect federation
scheme to challenge against, and what to label the button that starts it.

name.description: The health check's own registered name (for example, `storage`, `transports`).

status.description: This one component's own status: `Healthy`, `Degraded`, or `Unhealthy`.

description.description: A human-readable description of this component's own current state.

error.description: The message of an exception this check raised, if any, or null.

StatusComponent.description:
This class carries a single subsystem's own health-check result, part of an authenticated
Ninlil.Web.Models.StatusResponse.Components response.

components.description: The per-subsystem breakdown, present only for an authenticated caller with `status:read`.

StatusResponse.description:
This class carries a single response for `GET /status` -- an unauthenticated caller
(or one without the `status:read` permission claim) only ever receives
Ninlil.Web.Models.StatusResponse.Status populated, with Ninlil.Web.Models.StatusResponse.Components left null;
an authenticated caller holding `status:read` receives both, additively --
the granular per-component breakdown is the single source of truth
Ninlil.Web.Models.StatusResponse.Status itself is aggregated down from, not a separately maintained summary.

StorageEngineSwitchApiRequest.description:
This record is the real request body for `POST /api/storage/switch` -- structured,
per-engine connection fields rather than a single free-text connection string, mirroring
`EventBrokerSettingsController`'s own equivalent structured-field pattern. Only the
one section matching Ninlil.Web.Models.StorageEngineSwitchApiRequest.TargetEngine needs to be populated;
Ninlil.Web.Services.Storage.StorageConnectionStringAssembler reads only that section and
ignores the other three entirely.

totalEntitiesRestored.description: The total number of rows restored into Ninlil.Web.Models.StorageEngineSwitchResult.NewEngine, across every entity type.

entityCounts.description: How many rows of each entity type were restored, by name.

StorageEngineSwitchResult.description:
This record is returned once a storage-engine switch has finished successfully -- the
process is, at the moment this is returned, already reading and writing through
Ninlil.Web.Models.StorageEngineSwitchResult.NewEngine, with every row Ninlil.Web.Models.StorageEngineSwitchResult.TotalEntitiesRestored counts
already carried across from Ninlil.Web.Models.StorageEngineSwitchResult.PreviousEngine.

switchInProgress.description:
Whether a call to `POST /api/storage/switch` is genuinely underway in this process
right now.

liveSwitchSupportedEngines.description:
Every engine `POST /api/storage/switch` can genuinely switch to or from without a
restart -- the four relational engines Entity Framework Core serves against one shared
model. Ninlil.Dns.Common.Enum.StorageEngineEnum.MongoDb is deliberately absent: it is served by an
entirely separate repository implementation chosen once at process startup, not merely a
different connection through the same model, so switching to or from it still requires
editing configuration and restarting.

StorageStatus.description:
This record is the REST representation of this host's own currently active storage engine
-- deliberately omits the connection string itself (which may embed a password), the same
"never echo a raw secret back over the API" posture this project already applies to every
other credential type.

pfxPath.description:
The path to an operator-provided PKCS#12 certificate file, including its private key. Empty
means "generate and manage a self-signed certificate instead."

pfxPasswordConfigured.description:
Whether Ninlil.Dns.Server.Core.Certificates.TlsCertificateOptions.PfxPassword currently has a value -- the
password itself is never returned by a `GET`, the same reveal-once posture every other
secret-bearing setting in this project already follows.

selfSignedSubjectAlternativeNames.description:
The subject alternative names a self-signed certificate (generated only when
Ninlil.Web.Models.TlsCertificateSettingsDetail.PfxPath is empty) is issued for.

certificateReloadPollInterval.description:
How often this transport's own Ninlil.Dns.Server.Core.Certificates.ReloadableTlsCertificateProvider re-checks
whether the certificate this configuration points at has been replaced on disk.

allowedProtocols.description:
Which TLS protocol versions this transport's own handshake will accept, by name (for
example `["Tls12", "Tls13"]`). An empty list means System.Security.Authentication.SslProtocols.None
-- let the OS/runtime negotiate its own best-available default, per
Ninlil.Dns.Server.Core.Certificates.TlsCertificateOptions.AllowedProtocols's own doc comment.

TlsCertificateSettingsDetail.description:
This record is the REST representation of a TLS-based transport's own server certificate
configuration (Ninlil.Dns.Server.Core.Certificates.TlsCertificateOptions) -- shared by DNS-over-TLS and
DNS-over-QUIC, the two transports that actually consult it inside this host's own combined
process (DNS-over-HTTPS, mapped onto this host's shared Kestrel instance rather than
self-hosting its own, uses that shared listener's own certificate instead -- see
Ninlil.Web.Models.DnsOverHttpsSettingsDetail's own doc comment for why no equivalent field
exists there). Reflects the exact same "operator-provided PFX path, or a self-managed
self-signed certificate" shape Ninlil.Dns.Server.Core.Certificates.TlsCertificateOptions itself already uses --
this record does not introduce a raw-key-material upload flow, deliberately.

name.description: The key's name, matched against a signed message's own key name.

algorithmName.description:
The key's MAC algorithm. Ninlil implements only HMAC-SHA256; omitted or left blank,
this defaults to that algorithm.

secret.description:
The key's own shared secret, base64-encoded. When omitted, a cryptographically random
32-byte secret is generated instead -- either way, the plaintext secret is only ever
shown once, in this endpoint's own response; every later request for this key omits it.

isDisabled.description: Whether the key starts out disabled.

comments.description: Free-form operator notes about the key.

TsigKeyCreateRequest.description:
This class carries the fields used to create a new TSIG key
(`POST /api/tsig-keys`).

TsigKeyCreateResponse.description:
This class carries a newly created TSIG key's own metadata alongside its plaintext shared
secret -- the only response that will ever include Ninlil.Web.Models.TsigKeyCreateResponse.Secret, per this
project's reveal-once-then-omitted exposure policy for every secret-bearing entity type.

TsigKeyDetail.description:
This class carries a TSIG key's own metadata, for list, single-item, and (nested inside
Ninlil.Web.Models.TsigKeyCreateResponse) creation responses. The key's own shared secret is
never included here -- see Ninlil.Web.Models.TsigKeyCreateResponse for the one place it ever
appears.

skip.description: How many items were skipped before this page began.

take.description: The maximum number of items this page could contain.

totalCount.description: The total number of items across every page.

TsigKeyDetailPagedResult.description:
This class wraps a single page of a larger list -- the shape every list endpoint in this
project's REST API returns, offset/limit paginated (a sane default/max page size is enough
at this project's own homelab/small-org target scale; a cursor-based scheme's extra
complexity is not needed).

name.description: The key's name.

isDisabled.description: Whether the key is currently disabled.

comments.description: Free-form operator notes about the key.

TsigKeyWriteRequest.description:
This class carries the fields used to fully replace an existing TSIG key's metadata
(`PUT /api/tsig-keys/{id}`). The key's own shared secret cannot be rotated this way --
delete and recreate the key instead -- since the reveal-once-on-creation exposure policy
has no later point at which a rotated secret could be shown again through a `PUT`'s
own no-body `204` response.

TsigSettingsDetail.description:
This record is the REST representation of this host's own currently-effective
`TsigServiceOptions` -- the clock-skew tolerance written into every message this
server signs. Exposed as a plain System.Int32 even though the underlying options
property is a System.UInt16, since JSON has no unsigned 16-bit numeric type; a
`PATCH` to the same endpoint rejects anything outside 0-65535. This record's own field
is the exact same one a `PATCH` to the same endpoint accepts.

code.description: The time-based (authenticator app) or e-mailed verification code.

TwoFactorCodeRequest.description:
This class carries a single verification code, used both to confirm a newly-enrolled
authenticator and to disable two-factor authentication.

code.description: The time-based (authenticator app) or e-mailed verification code.

provider.description:
Which second factor Code was generated by: `"Authenticator"`,
`"Email"`, or `"RecoveryCode"` (one of the caller's own single-use fallback
codes, from `POST /api/auth/two-factor/recovery-codes/generate`, redeemed and
invalidated by this same call rather than merely checked).

rememberMe.description: The same choice Ninlil.Web.Models.LoginRequest.RememberMe describes, repeated for this final step.

TwoFactorLoginRequest.description:
This class carries the second-factor code a caller submits to finish a sign-in that
Ninlil.Web.Models.LoginResponse.RequiresTwoFactor flagged as still pending.

isEnabled.description: Whether a second factor is currently required at sign-in.

hasAuthenticator.description:
Whether an authenticator app shared secret has already been generated for this account
(regardless of whether two-factor sign-in is currently required) -- lets the UI offer
"re-enroll" rather than "enroll" wording.

canReceiveEmailCode.description:
Whether this account has a confirmed e-mail address the e-mailed-code action
(`POST .../two-factor/email/send`) could actually deliver a code to.

recoveryCodesRemaining.description:
How many of this account's own single-use recovery codes have not yet been redeemed. Zero
both when two-factor authentication is not enabled at all and when it is enabled but no
recovery code batch has ever been generated -- the UI is expected to prompt the caller to
generate a batch (or a fresh one) whenever this is low, the same way it would after any
other secret nears the end of its usefulness.

TwoFactorStatus.description: This class carries the current caller's own two-factor enrollment state.

UpdateRoleRequest.description: This class carries the settings that can be changed on an existing role.

displayName.description: The account's new friendly display name.

isDisabled.description: Whether the account should be disabled (rejected at sign-in).

UpdateUserRequest.description:
This class carries the settings that can be changed on an existing user account.
Password changes are handled separately, not through this endpoint.

UserAppearancePreferenceDetail.description:
This record is the REST representation of the current caller's own appearance preference:
their own override, if any, alongside the effective value the Angular admin SPA's own
theming engine should actually render, after falling back to this host's own global default
for whichever field (if either) is not overridden.

UserPermissionRequest.description:
This class carries a single permission claim to grant or revoke directly on a user,
independent of any role they hold.

email.description: The account's e-mail address, if any. Read-only here.

displayName.description: The account's friendly display name, if any.

phoneNumber.description: The account's phone number, if any.

UserProfileDetail.description:
This class carries the current caller's own self-service profile -- display name, phone
number, and e-mail address -- reachable via M:Ninlil.Web.Controllers.UsersController.GetMine
and M:Ninlil.Web.Controllers.UsersController.PatchMine(System.Text.Json.JsonElement). Ninlil.Web.Models.UserProfileDetail.Email is included
purely for display and so the Angular admin SPA's own Profile page can compute this
account's Gravatar hash client-side; it is deliberately read-only through this pair of
actions (an e-mail change needs its own re-verification flow this project does not yet
build -- see `UpdateUserRequest`, the administrative equivalent, for the one path that
can still change it today).

roleName.description: The name of the role to grant or revoke.

UserRoleAssignmentRequest.description: This class carries the role a user should be granted or revoked.

email.description: The account's e-mail address, if any.

displayName.description: The account's friendly display name, if any.

isDisabled.description: Whether the account is currently disabled.

twoFactorEnabled.description: Whether the account requires a second authentication factor.

roles.description: The names of every role this account currently holds.

directPermissions.description:
Every permission granted to this account directly, independent of any role it holds --
distinct from whatever a role it holds might separately grant, mirroring
Ninlil.Web.Models.RoleSummary.Permissions's own shape one level down.

originatingNodeId.description:
The cluster node this account was most recently created or modified on, or
null on a single-node deployment (or for an account that predates Phase
9-6d's own identity/RBAC cluster federation) -- mirrors `FilterListDetail`'s own field
of the same name and purpose, rendered the same way via the Angular admin SPA's shared
`ClusterSyncInfoComponent`.

clusterConflictNote.description:
A human-readable explanation of a genuine cluster username collision this account lost,
surfaced so an administrator can see it was renamed/overwritten rather than silently
dropped or merged -- see `UserEntity.ClusterConflictNote`'s own doc comment.
null for the overwhelming majority of accounts, which never collided
with anything.

lastModifiedUtc.description:
The instant this account was last created or modified (<c>AuditableEntityBaseExtensions
.GetLastModifiedUtc()</c>) -- paired with Ninlil.Web.Models.UserSummary.OriginatingNodeId by the Angular
admin SPA's own shared `ClusterSyncInfoComponent`, mirroring every cluster-synced
entity summary's own field of the same name and purpose.

UserSummary.description: This class carries a user account's own summary, for administrative listing purposes.

skip.description: How many items were skipped before this page began.

take.description: The maximum number of items this page could contain.

totalCount.description: The total number of items across every page.

UserSummaryPagedResult.description:
This class wraps a single page of a larger list -- the shape every list endpoint in this
project's REST API returns, offset/limit paginated (a sane default/max page size is enough
at this project's own homelab/small-org target scale; a cursor-based scheme's extra
complexity is not needed).

httpPort.description: The plain HTTP port this host binds to.

httpsPort.description: The HTTPS port this host binds to.

WebListenSettingsDetail.description:
This record is the REST representation of this host's own currently-effective
`WebListenOptions` -- the admin web listener's own port/certificate configuration,
shared by the REST API, the SignalR hub, and DNS-over-HTTPS. No secret material other than
Ninlil.Web.Models.WebListenSettingsDetail.Certificate's own reveal-once `PfxPasswordConfigured` field is involved,
so every other field is the exact same one a `PATCH` to the same endpoint accepts.

subscriptionId.description: The identifier of the subscription this delivery targets.

subscriptionName.description:
The subscription's own name, snapshotted at the moment this delivery was first created --
so a delivery record stays meaningful even if the subscription it targeted has since been
renamed or deleted.

eventTypeName.description: The registered event type name this delivery carries (for example, `"DnsZoneChanged"`).

payloadJson.description:
The exact outbound JSON request body this delivery sends (or already sent) on every
attempt -- captured once, at creation time, so a retry (by the same process or a freshly
restarted one) always sends byte-identical content.

attemptCount.description: How many delivery attempts have actually been made so far.

maxAttempts.description:
The maximum number of delivery attempts this delivery may ever make -- a snapshot of the
target subscription's own Ninlil.Web.Models.WebhookSubscriptionDetail.MaxDeliveryAttempts at
the moment this row was first created.

lastAttemptedAtUtc.description: When this delivery's own most recent attempt occurred, or null if never attempted yet.

nextRetryDueUtc.description:
When this delivery's own next retry attempt is due, or null once
Ninlil.Web.Models.WebhookDeliveryAttemptDetail.Status has reached a terminal outcome.

lastHttpStatusCode.description:
The HTTP status code the subscriber's own endpoint returned on this delivery's own most
recent attempt, or null if that attempt failed before a response was
ever received.

lastErrorMessage.description: A short, human-readable description of this delivery's own most recent failure, or null if its most recent (or only) attempt succeeded.

completedAtUtc.description: When this delivery reached its own terminal outcome, or null while still pending.

createdAtUtc.description: When this delivery was first recorded (its own first attempt).

WebhookDeliveryAttemptDetail.description:
This class carries a single persisted webhook delivery attempt's own current state, for
`GET /api/webhooks/{id}/delivery-attempts` -- the real, on-disk delivery history
`Server.Webhooks`'s own `WebhookDeliveryAttemptEntity` tracks, surfaced entirely
read-only. There is no corresponding write DTO: a delivery attempt is written exclusively
by `WebhookDeliveryService`/`WebhookDeliveryRetrySweepService` as a real delivery
is attempted, never authored or edited by an operator.

skip.description: How many items were skipped before this page began.

take.description: The maximum number of items this page could contain.

totalCount.description: The total number of items across every page.

WebhookDeliveryAttemptDetailPagedResult.description:
This class wraps a single page of a larger list -- the shape every list endpoint in this
project's REST API returns, offset/limit paginated (a sane default/max page size is enough
at this project's own homelab/small-org target scale; a cursor-based scheme's extra
complexity is not needed).

WebhookDeliverySettingsDetail.description:
This record is the REST representation of this host's own currently-effective
`WebhookDeliveryOptions` -- the shared retry/backoff timing and outbound HTTP timeout
every webhook subscription's own deliveries use. This record's own fields are the exact
same ones a `PATCH` to the same endpoint accepts.

name.description: An operator-chosen, human-readable, unique name for this subscription.

targetUrl.description: The absolute URL every matching event is POSTed to.

eventTypeNames.description:
Which event types this subscription wants delivered, by their own registered
`DnsServerEventTypeRegistry` name (for example, `"DnsZoneChanged"`) -- validated
against that real registry before this subscription is ever persisted, rather than
accepting an arbitrary string, the same "validate against the real registry/parser"
discipline Ninlil.Web.Models.ForwarderWriteRequest's own `DefinitionString` already
applies.

authCredentials.description:
This subscription's own outbound authentication credential(s), required when
Ninlil.Web.Models.WebhookSubscriptionCreateRequest.AuthMode is not `None` -- `{"BearerToken":"..."}` for
`Bearer`, or `{"Username":"...","Password":"..."}` for `Basic`. These are
always operator-supplied (this server never generates a bearer token or password on an
operator's behalf, unlike a TSIG key's own shared secret) and are returned exactly once,
in this endpoint's own response, and never again afterward.

enableHmacSigning.description:
Whether this subscription signs its own outbound payloads with an HMAC secret, delivered
via a header the delivery engine adds (for example, `X-Ninlil-Signature`)
so the receiver can verify authenticity.

hmacSigningSecret.description:
This subscription's own HMAC payload-signing secret, used only when
Ninlil.Web.Models.WebhookSubscriptionCreateRequest.EnableHmacSigning is true. When omitted, a
cryptographically random secret is generated instead -- either way, the plaintext secret
is only ever shown once, in this endpoint's own response; every later request for this
subscription omits it. Once set, this secret can only be rotated or disabled by deleting
and recreating the subscription -- neither `PUT` nor `PATCH` can touch it, the
same reveal-once limitation Ninlil.Web.Models.TsigKeyWriteRequest already documents for a
TSIG key's own server-generated secret.

maxDeliveryAttempts.description:
The maximum number of delivery attempts the delivery engine makes for a single
event before giving up and logging the failure.

isDisabled.description: Whether the subscription starts out disabled.

comments.description: Free-form operator notes about this subscription.

WebhookSubscriptionCreateRequest.description:
This class carries the fields used to create a new outbound webhook subscription
(`POST /api/webhooks`). See Ninlil.Web.Models.WebhookSubscriptionCreateResponse for the
one place Ninlil.Web.Models.WebhookSubscriptionCreateRequest.AuthCredentials/the resulting HMAC signing secret are ever shown.

authCredentials.description:
The subscription's own outbound authentication credential(s), or null
when Ninlil.Web.Models.WebhookSubscriptionDetail.AuthMode is `None`.

hmacSigningSecret.description:
The subscription's own HMAC signing secret (caller-supplied or freshly generated), or
null when signing was not enabled.

WebhookSubscriptionCreateResponse.description:
This class carries a newly created webhook subscription's own metadata alongside its
plaintext auth credential(s) and, if enabled, its plaintext HMAC signing secret -- the
only response that will ever include either, per this project's reveal-once-then-omitted
exposure policy for every secret-bearing entity type.

name.description: The subscription's own name.

targetUrl.description: The absolute URL every matching event is POSTed to.

eventTypeNames.description: Which event types this subscription is subscribed to.

hasHmacSigningSecret.description:
Whether this subscription has an HMAC signing secret configured -- a plain boolean flag,
never the secret itself, so a caller can tell whether payload signing is active without
this response ever exposing the secret it would need to verify one.

maxDeliveryAttempts.description: The maximum number of delivery attempts the delivery engine makes.

isDisabled.description: Whether this subscription is currently disabled.

comments.description: Free-form operator notes about this subscription.

updatedAtUtc.description: When this subscription was last modified, or null if never.

WebhookSubscriptionDetail.description:
This class carries a webhook subscription's own metadata, for list, single-item, and
(nested inside Ninlil.Web.Models.WebhookSubscriptionCreateResponse) creation responses.
Neither the subscription's own auth credential(s) nor its HMAC signing secret are ever
included here -- see Ninlil.Web.Models.WebhookSubscriptionCreateResponse for the one place
Ninlil.Web.Models.WebhookSubscriptionCreateResponse.AuthCredentials/
Ninlil.Web.Models.WebhookSubscriptionCreateResponse.HmacSigningSecret ever appear.

skip.description: How many items were skipped before this page began.

take.description: The maximum number of items this page could contain.

totalCount.description: The total number of items across every page.

WebhookSubscriptionDetailPagedResult.description:
This class wraps a single page of a larger list -- the shape every list endpoint in this
project's REST API returns, offset/limit paginated (a sane default/max page size is enough
at this project's own homelab/small-org target scale; a cursor-based scheme's extra
complexity is not needed).

name.description: The subscription's name.

targetUrl.description: The absolute URL every matching event is POSTed to.

eventTypeNames.description: Which event types this subscription wants delivered, replacing the entire set.

authCredentials.description: This subscription's own outbound authentication credential(s), replacing them entirely.

maxDeliveryAttempts.description: The maximum number of delivery attempts the delivery engine makes.

isDisabled.description: Whether the subscription is currently disabled.

comments.description: Free-form operator notes about this subscription.

WebhookSubscriptionWriteRequest.description:
This class carries the fields used to fully replace an existing webhook subscription's
metadata and auth credentials (`PUT /api/webhooks/{id}`). Unlike a TSIG key's own
server-generated shared secret, Ninlil.Web.Models.WebhookSubscriptionWriteRequest.AuthCredentials is always operator-supplied
-- the caller already knows the exact plaintext value being submitted in this very request
-- so, exactly like Ninlil.Web.Models.CloudProviderCredentialWriteRequest, a `PUT` may
replace it too, with no "how do we reveal a rotated value again" problem. This subscription's
own HMAC signing secret (see Ninlil.Web.Models.WebhookSubscriptionCreateRequest.HmacSigningSecret)
cannot be touched this way at all -- delete and recreate the subscription instead.

recordsAdded.description: How many CAA records this pass created.

recordsRemoved.description: How many CAA records this pass removed as no longer desired.

skipped.description:
Whether this pass did no work at all (see SkipReason) -- distinct from
a pass that ran but found nothing to change (reported as false here with
zero counts).

skipReason.description: Why this pass was skipped, populated only when Skipped is true.

ZoneCaaReconciliationResponse.description:
This record is `POST /api/zones/{id}/reconcile-caa`'s own response body -- what one
on-demand CAA reconciliation pass actually did, or why it did nothing at all. A thin REST
wrapper over `Server.Acme.Caa.CaaReconciliationResult`, following this project's own
"never expose an internal service-layer result type directly over REST" convention (the
same reasoning `ZoneCatalogMembersResponse` already establishes for
`CatalogZoneMembershipService.ListMembersAsync`'s own return value).

memberZoneNames.description: Every member zone name the catalog currently lists, alphabetically.

ZoneCatalogMembersResponse.description:
This class carries a single catalog zone's own currently-enumerated member zone names --
`GET /api/zones/{id}/catalog-members`'s own response body.

catalogZoneId.description: The identifier of the Ninlil.Dns.Common.Enum.ZoneTypeEnum.Catalog zone to join.

ZoneCatalogMembershipRequest.description:
This class carries the catalog zone a caller wants a zone to join --
`POST /api/zones/{id}/catalog-membership`'s own request body.

name.description: The zone's fully-qualified name, without a trailing dot.

isDnssecSigned.description: Whether the zone is signed with DNSSEC.

nsec3Iterations.description: How many additional times a signed zone's NSEC3 chain hashes.

nsec3SaltHex.description: A signed zone's NSEC3 salt, as hexadecimal text.

isDisabled.description: Whether the zone is currently disabled.

primaryServerAddresses.description: The upstream name servers this zone transfers from, for a secondary/stub zone.

forwarderAddresses.description: The addresses this zone forwards every query to.

notifyAddresses.description: The secondaries this zone sends an outbound NOTIFY to.

tsigKeyName.description: The TSIG key this zone signs its outbound transfer requests with.

dynamicUpdateEnabled.description: Whether this zone accepts RFC 2136 dynamic updates.

comments.description: Free-form operator notes about the zone.

cloudProviderCredentialId.description: The credential this zone syncs against, for a cloud zone.

cloudProviderZoneId.description: This zone's own identifier at its cloud provider.

cloudSyncInterval.description: How often this zone's cloud sync runs.

autoManageCaaRecords.description:
Whether the CAA auto-management feature reconciles this zone's CAA records.
null inherits `CaaAutoManagementOptions.DefaultEnabled`.

caaIssuerDomain.description:
This zone's own override of which CA issuer domain CAA auto-management writes
into the CAA records it creates. null inherits
`CaaAutoManagementOptions.DefaultIssuerDomain`.

autoManagePtrRecords.description:
Whether the PTR/reverse-zone sync feature mirrors this zone's own A/AAAA records
into the enclosing reverse zone. null inherits
`PtrSyncOptions.DefaultEnabled`.

ptrIpv4PrefixLength.description:
This zone's own override of the IPv4 reverse-zone grouping granularity, in bits.
null inherits `PtrSyncOptions.DefaultIpv4ReverseZonePrefixBits`.

ptrIpv6PrefixLength.description:
This zone's own override of the IPv6 reverse-zone grouping granularity, in bits.
null inherits `PtrSyncOptions.DefaultIpv6ReverseZonePrefixBits`.

updatedAtUtc.description: When the zone was last updated, if it ever has been.

memberOfCatalogZoneId.description:
The identifier of the RFC 9432 catalog zone this zone is a member of, or
null if it participates in none. Read-only here -- set or cleared only
through `POST`/`DELETE /api/zones/{id}/catalog-membership`, never through this
record's own create/replace/patch counterparts.

ZoneDetail.description: This class carries a zone's full state, for both list and single-item responses.

skip.description: How many items were skipped before this page began.

take.description: The maximum number of items this page could contain.

totalCount.description: The total number of items across every page.

ZoneDetailPagedResult.description:
This class wraps a single page of a larger list -- the shape every list endpoint in this
project's REST API returns, offset/limit paginated (a sane default/max page size is enough
at this project's own homelab/small-org target scale; a cursor-based scheme's extra
complexity is not needed).

recordsAdded.description:
How many PTR/delegation-CNAME records this pass created, across every reverse zone and
(for a classless IPv4 grouping) every RFC 2317 delegating parent zone touched.

recordsRemoved.description: The same, for records removed as no longer desired.

reverseZonesTouched.description:
How many distinct zones this pass created, wrote into, or visited for stale-record
cleanup.

skipped.description:
Whether this pass did no work at all (see SkipReason) -- distinct from
a pass that ran but found nothing to change (reported as false here with
zero counts).

skipReason.description: Why this pass was skipped, populated only when Skipped is true.

ZonePtrReconciliationResponse.description:
This record is `POST /api/zones/{id}/reconcile-ptr`'s own response body -- what one
on-demand PTR/reverse-zone sync reconciliation pass actually did, or why it did nothing at
all. A thin REST wrapper over `Server.Authoritative.Ptr.PtrReconciliationResult`, the
same shape Ninlil.Web.Models.ZoneCaaReconciliationResponse uses for its own equivalent result.

signatureValidityPeriod.description: How long a freshly computed signature remains valid.

inceptionOffset.description: How far before the actual signing time a signature's own inception is deliberately backdated.

refreshBeforeExpiration.description: How long before a zone's earliest-expiring signature actually expires that a proactive re-sign runs.

pollInterval.description: How often the proactive re-signing background loop wakes up to check whether any signed zone is due.

ZoneSigningSettingsDetail.description:
This record is the REST representation of this host's own currently-effective
`ZoneSigningOptions` -- the timing parameters `ZoneSigningService` signs with and
`DnssecResigningBackgroundService` re-signs against. No secret material is involved,
so this record's own fields are the exact same ones a `PATCH` to the same endpoint
accepts.

ZoneTransferClientSettingsDetail.description:
This record is the REST representation of this host's own currently-effective
`ZoneTransferClientOptions` -- how this server pulls AXFR/IXFR transfers from a
primary as a secondary. This record's own fields are the exact same ones a `PATCH` to
the same endpoint accepts.

ZoneTransferSettingsDetail.description:
This record is the REST representation of this host's own currently-effective
`ZoneTransferOptions` -- how this server chunks AXFR/IXFR responses it serves out to a
secondary. This record's own fields are the exact same ones a `PATCH` to the same
endpoint accepts.

name.description: The zone's fully-qualified name, without a trailing dot.

isDnssecSigned.description: Whether the zone is signed with DNSSEC.

nsec3Iterations.description: How many additional times a signed zone's NSEC3 chain hashes.

nsec3SaltHex.description: A signed zone's NSEC3 salt, as hexadecimal text.

isDisabled.description: Whether the zone is currently disabled.

primaryServerAddresses.description: The upstream name servers this zone transfers from, for a secondary/stub zone.

forwarderAddresses.description: The addresses this zone forwards every query to.

notifyAddresses.description: The secondaries this zone sends an outbound NOTIFY to.

tsigKeyName.description: The TSIG key this zone signs its outbound transfer requests with.

dynamicUpdateEnabled.description: Whether this zone accepts RFC 2136 dynamic updates.

comments.description: Free-form operator notes about the zone.

cloudProviderCredentialId.description: The credential this zone syncs against, for a cloud zone.

cloudProviderZoneId.description: This zone's own identifier at its cloud provider.

cloudSyncInterval.description: How often this zone's cloud sync runs.

autoManageCaaRecords.description:
Whether the CAA auto-management feature reconciles this zone's CAA records.
null inherits `CaaAutoManagementOptions.DefaultEnabled`.

caaIssuerDomain.description:
This zone's own override of which CA issuer domain CAA auto-management writes
into the CAA records it creates. null inherits
`CaaAutoManagementOptions.DefaultIssuerDomain`.

autoManagePtrRecords.description:
Whether the PTR/reverse-zone sync feature mirrors this zone's own A/AAAA records
into the enclosing reverse zone. null inherits
`PtrSyncOptions.DefaultEnabled` (which itself defaults to false --
unlike CAA auto-management, this feature is opt-in).

ptrIpv4PrefixLength.description:
This zone's own override of the IPv4 reverse-zone grouping granularity, in bits, or
null to inherit `PtrSyncOptions.DefaultIpv4ReverseZonePrefixBits`.
A value of `24` (the conventional octet boundary) behaves exactly as before RFC 2317
support existed; `25`-`30` switches to RFC 2317's own classless delegation.
Validated at the write boundary to be either `null` or within `24`-`30`
inclusive.

ptrIpv6PrefixLength.description:
This zone's own override of the IPv6 reverse-zone grouping granularity, in bits, or
null to inherit `PtrSyncOptions.DefaultIpv6ReverseZonePrefixBits`.
Validated at the write boundary to be either `null` or a multiple of `4` between
`16` and `124` inclusive.

ZoneWriteRequest.description:
This class carries every writable field of a `ZoneEntity` -- used both to create a
new zone (`POST /api/zones`) and to fully replace an existing one
(`PUT /api/zones/{id}`), since the two share an identical field set. A zone's records
(starting with its own SOA) are managed separately, through the nested
`/api/zones/{zoneId}/records` endpoints -- creating a zone here only creates its
metadata shell.

Bearer.description: A JSON Web Token access token issued by POST /api/auth/login.
